page.overview:
Who is Lawrence Lorelei?

is a human blood hunter and a member of the Lorelei family. He was played by Travis Willingham in .

In his human form Lawrence looks like a man of dark skin (although lighter than those of his two oldest siblings) with a soft purple hue (sign of his drow ancestry), dark eyes and long black hair (with white racing stripes starting at his temples) but not quite touching the shoulders; he also has a slight stubble of black beard. He wears black and green clothes, with vine patterns on some of his garments. Lawrence has features in common with his brother Benicio, but they are not identical twins: beyond the style and personal aesthetics of each one, the older twin has a more pronounced jaw, and lacks the scars of the younger twin; furthermore, they both have distinct white hair patterns.

In his werewolf form, Lawrence's head is jet black with white racing stripes coming back from his eyes. The black only extends to his mid-sternum, and the rest of his body is peppered salty gray, black and white, with dappled spots.

Lawrence was studious and serious-minded. He was also often accused of being cowardly by his siblings. While he is willing to offer his family whatever they require, his true love is logic and reason.
